Morgan (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. We heard a lot about why we win/loselet's capture immediate asks and owners so we can close the loop.
Priya (CS): High-level themes from CS: compliance & residency, onboarding friction for POCs, and billing unpredictability for bursty usage.
Kemi (Sales): Adding color: lost two deals this quarter specifically for VPC/on-prem requirements; another pushed because we didn't have a prebuilt connector to their legacy CRM. Wins often cited a dedicated onboarding engineer and a short POC template.
Alex (Product): Action items I can own: 1) POC runbook template (POC config, success metrics, sample infra). 2) One-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private (ops + cost). ETA: 7 days.
Jonas (Eng): Low-effort wins to reduce latency complaints: default batching tweaks, enable prefix KV caching for POCs, and publish recommended kernel profiles for common GPUs. I'll draft the latency playbook.
Aisha (Security): I'll produce the compliance checklist and a network/KMS example snippet customers can reuse. ETA: 10 days.
Priya (CS): I'll compile anonymized loss notes and win patterns, add a prioritized connector wishlist, and coordinate with Sales. Owner: Priya + Kemi. ETA: 2 weeks.
Kemi (Sales): Will upload sanitized loss notes to #sales-docs and link them here. Also will flag priority customers for immediate outreach.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-3460: "all-hands: customer feedback artifacts + playbooks" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3460)
Morgan (CEO): Please add owners and due dates to the GitHub issue and tag @eng for connector quickstarts. Let's review progress at next leadership sync. Thanks all.
